# Not building: Workspace invites (`workspace-invites`)

- **NB-1** — Inviting many people at once (a pasted list or a file) — not building: one at a time covers the team sizes he named; a bulk form needs its own error handling
- **NB-2** — A second invite to an e-mail that already has a pending one — not building: the form refuses it with the pending row shown; resending is NB-4
- **NB-3** — Reusing a link after it was accepted — not building: the link opens the workspace's sign-in page, as every other old link does
- **NB-4** — Resending or extending a pending invite — later: he wants to see how often invites expire first
